note: Measured on this machine with a synthetic token stream. The synthetic stream is a hardware probe only and is never used for a reported training result.

measurements.verdict: exceeds VRAM - spilled to shared memory, throughput collapsed

interpretation: Peak allocations above 6.44 GB did not raise OutOfMemoryError because Windows WDDM silently spills to host memory. Throughput falling from 16,075 to 1,193 tokens/s is the real signal that those configurations do not fit. They are rejected.

selected_configuration.rationale: Inside the 10-50M parameter range the specification asks for, uses half the available VRAM so gradient accumulation can raise the effective batch without risk, and sustains ~43k tokens/s which makes a multi-epoch run practical in hours rather than days.
